_doc: House voice standard v4.0 (empirically calibrated 2026-11-25 on 54 real raw VieNeu Hai Dang sentences vs 28 SCRIPT_YOUTUBE ref Shorts): lively natural Hai Dang at pitch_ratio 1.00 (zero pitch warp), target_ups 5.05, phonation_ups 5.45, blend_raw 0.30, tempo_clamp [0.95, 1.20], inside_pause >0.38s -> 0.18s, sentence_gap_s 0.15s, clause_pad_s 0.03s, short_sentence_pad_s 0.00s. Measured real output: 4.57 overall wps (vs ref median 4.59 [4.52-4.71]), 20.1% RMS audio pause share (vs ref 19.6-22.0%), median tempo 1.11x.

engine._why: VieNeu V3 Turbo preset Hai Dang with use_ref_codes=True, calibrated empirically against real raw sentences to hit exact 4.55-4.62 overall wps and ~20% RMS pause breathing room at pitch_ratio=1.00 without robotic >1.20x rushing or sluggish 4.02 wps drag.

rhythm._doc: v4.0 Empirically Calibrated Hai Dang Rhythm: hits 4.57 wps overall and 20.1% RMS pause share at pitch 1.00 with gentle [0.95, 1.20] WSOLA clamp. Eliminates both v2.0 frantic 1.39x spikes and v3.0 sluggish 4.02 wps drag.

text._doc: Rules for spoken text (tts_text if present, else text). script_lint SC-15..SC-17 and voice.py enforce them.
text._why: Numbers must be written in words; '...' / '…' / '—' / '–' are allowed and receive 0.03s clause_pad_s while internal pauses >0.38s trim gently to 0.18s; VieNeu V3 Turbo native inline emotion tokens are allowed and stripped from captions; English proper nouns use <en>...</en> or top-level 'english': [...].

line_checks._doc: Every segment is measured against profile (below). [min, max]. Offending sentences regenerate with next deterministic seed up to engine.max_attempts.

episode_checks._between_words_why: Same chain and measure as G6 (audiolib.voice_chain + between_words_db). Measured at G3 so noisy takes are caught before shots are timed.

profile._doc: Empirically calibrated v4.0 Hai Dang profile (target_ups 5.05, pitch_ratio 1.00, inside holes >0.38s -> 0.18s, measured overall_wps 4.57, RMS pause 20.1%).
profile.calibrated: 2026-11-25, VieNeu V3 Turbo Hai Dang preset empirically calibrated on 54 real raw sentences vs 28 SCRIPT_YOUTUBE ref Shorts (overall_wps 4.57 vs ref median 4.59).
